structures.name: Corona Radiata
structures.about: The fan of projection fibers radiating from the internal capsule up into the cerebral cortex.

structures.name: Cingulate Gyrus
structures.about: The cortical gyrus arching directly above the corpus callosum, part of the limbic system.

structures.name: Cingulum
structures.about: The bundle of association fibers running lengthwise inside the cingulate gyrus.

structures.name: Corpus Callosum
structures.about: The great commissure joining the two cerebral hemispheres, seen in section as a broad white band above the ventricles.

structures.name: Lateral Ventricle
structures.about: The paired cerebrospinal fluid cavities within each cerebral hemisphere, curving beneath the corpus callosum.
